questions.question: After Israel split from Judah, what did King Jeroboam fear might happen to his kingdom?

answers.text: It might go back to the house of David
It might be taken over by Egypt
It might be split among his sons

questions.question: To keep his people from worshiping in Jerusalem, what did King Jeroboam make after seeking advice?
King Jeroboam set up one golden calf in Bethel. In which city did he set up the other?
Who did King Jeroboam appoint as priests for the shrines he built on the high places?

answers.text: People from every class who were not Levites
Only Levites who came up from Judah
Only elders who once served Solomon
